web.title: Employment termination payments for employees
web.description:
# Employment termination payments for employees
## What is an ETP?
- lump sum payments for [unused annual or long service leave](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/employment-termination-payments-for-employees#Taxonunusedentitlementswhenyouleaveajob)

## Tax on unused entitlements when you leave a job
If you receive any lump sum payments from your employer for unused annual leave or long service leave, you may pay [tax at a lower rate](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/paygw-schedule-7-tax-table-from-13-october-2020-to-30-june-2024) than your other income. These lump sum payments will appear at either 'Lump sum A' or 'Lump sum B' on your income statement or payment summary.
